title: Build two type traits
description:
A type trait is a class template that answers a question about a type, or transforms it, using partial specialization. Write two from scratch (inside namespace `my`, so they do not clash with the standard ones):

- `my::IsSame<T, U>` with a `static constexpr bool value`: `true` only when the two types are identical. Also the shortcut `my::isSame<T, U>` as a variable template.
- `my::RemoveConst<T>` with a nested `type`: `T` with a top-level `const` stripped off. Also the alias `my::RemoveConst_t<T>`.
